language.label: Language
language.partial: Only days of the week and months

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.description: Expands the Basic template by adding individual day itineraries.

blank.label: Blank
blank.description: Based on Basic template, but with empty habits, TODOs, special dates, etc.

upload.error: Was not able to load ReCalendar config from this PDF - are you sure it was generated using this website?

left-handed.label: Left-handed version
left-handed.description: Optimizes the layout for left-handed use.

sidebar.label: Leave permanent space for the toolbar
sidebar.description: If you prefer to keep the toolbar always open, check this option to make sure the calendar's content will never be covered by it.

offset.label: Toolbar size
offset.description: How much space to reserve for the toolbar, in points. Pre-filled with a value that works for the selected device - adjust it if the toolbar still covers the calendar's content.

starting-month.label: Starting month
starting-month.description: The first month in the generated calendar. Choose something like October if you want your calendar to cover a semester, instead of a calendar year.

month-count.label: Number of months
month-count.description: For how many months should the calendar be generated for.

lines.title: Itinerary lines
lines.description: The ruling used in itineraries - on day pages, week retrospectives, month overviews and year notes.

line-style.label: Style
line-style.description: Just like the ruling in a paper notebook.

line-height.label: Line height
line-height.description: Height of each line in itineraries. Text and icons scale with it, and it sets the vertical spacing of the grid and dot grid.

line-spacing.label: Grid spacing
line-spacing.description: Horizontal distance between the grid lines or dots, in the same units as the line height. Leave at 0 to match the line height, giving you square cells. The grid always starts one spacing in from the edge, the way paper notebooks keep a margin.

line-opacity.label: Opacity
line-opacity.description: How visible the lines and dots are. 0% hides them completely, 100% makes them fully black.

dateTemplate.label: Date formatting help
dateTemplate.title: Date templates
dateTemplate.description: Include formatted dates using <0/> or <1/>. See <2>available formats</2>.

button.copy: Copy this itinerary to all other days

notes.title: Year notes
notes.description: Year notes is a place to set the goals, plans and dreams for the upcoming year. One page is added at the start of the calendar, and another before each new year that it spans.

month.title: Month overview
month.description: The month overview is a place to set goals for the upcoming month, track habits and make other plans.

week.title: Week overview
week.description: Week overview gives you a zoom out of the week to makes plans easier.

retrospective.title: Week retrospective
retrospective.description: Week retrospective is a place to reflect on the past week - how it went, what did you learn, what could you improve for next week?

special-dates.title: Special dates
special-dates.description: Add your birthdays, celebrations, events, etc. here to get reminders about them in weekly overviews and day pages as they approach.

holidays.heading: Import national holidays
holidays.description_one: Pick a country to import its public holidays for the year ({{years}}) your calendar covers.
holidays.description_other: Pick a country to import its public holidays for the years ({{years}}) your calendar covers.
holidays.countries-error: Could not load the list of countries. Please check your connection and try again.

deduplicate.label: Skip duplicates
deduplicate.help: When on, a holiday that already exists on the same day (matched by its English name) won't be added again. Turn it off if you want the same holiday in more than one language - handy if you're learning a language or are a dual citizen.

holidays.error: Could not load holidays for this country. Please try again.
holidays.year-unavailable: Sorry, holidays are only available for the years {{years}}.
